info.title: Close-out governed API - draft
info.description: Review proposal, not a deployed API. No tenant-specific server or OAuth endpoint is assumed. The generated self-contained OpenAPI artifact resolves schema URNs for import. APIM validates Entra bearer tokens and trusted actor scopes; request bodies never grant approval.

get.description: Authorize site/program and submitted-package scope before streaming Blob content.

post.description: Proposed multipart boundary. Metadata is JSON; uploader identity is derived from authentication. Upload deduplication semantics require review.

201.description: Created logical metadata; processing is asynchronous

post.description: Re-read trusted ReworkApproved decision and policy evidence before mutation.
Reject execution until closure actor/policy is agreed and accepted current evidence is verified.
Verify closure actor/policy, site scope, current accepted photo and target version.
Re-read trusted SubmissionApproved decision, readiness and package before writing the milestone.

EntraBearer.description: TODO(verify) issuer, audience, app roles and delegated scopes per environment.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: caseId plus transition. Replays return the original durable receipt; same key with changed logical input returns 409. Occurrence/action discrimination for repeated transitions requires owner agreement.

CaseId.name: x-case-id
CaseId.description: Omit before case creation; otherwise match metadata caseId.

RequiredCaseId.name: x-case-id
RequiredCaseId.description: Must match the body's caseId and authorized record.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Optional header representation of the required expectedVersion body field; if both are supplied they must agree. Stale versions return 412. No wildcard overwrite. ETag encoding and creation target require review.

Receipt.description: Completed action or replay of its original durable receipt

ActionError.description: Structured error. Proposed statuses: 400 invalid input, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 missing resource, 409 key conflict, 412 stale version, 503 transient dependency failure. No confidential details in messages.

ReadinessSignal.title: ReadinessSignal
ReadinessSignal.description: Draft body of the Activator to Power Automate signal, not the event/message envelope.

readinessMissing.description: Proposed condition ID list; detailed shape requires cross-track agreement.

AgentOutput.title: AgentOutput
AgentOutput.description: Proposed agent outputs are recommendations/manifests, never approval or execution authority.

PackageManifest.title: PackageManifest
PackageManifest.description: Manifest must be checked against current accepted evidence before PackageReady. File conversion and Dataverse storage are not yet agreed.

BusinessAction.title: BusinessAction
BusinessAction.description: Proposed APIM boundaries. Inputs are untrusted: the executor must re-read trusted approval/evidence and target versions.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque target SoR version, not the Dataverse rowVersion. Target for creation needs owner agreement.

transitionOccurrenceId.description: Optional proposal for repeated transitions; key composition requires all-track review.

CloseReworkRequest.title: CloseReworkRequest
CloseReworkRequest.description: Closure authorization source/trigger is unresolved; evidence alone is not approval.

ClosePunchListRequest.title: ClosePunchListRequest
ClosePunchListRequest.description: Closing photo must be authorized, current and accepted; closure actor/policy needs owner agreement.

UploadMetadata.title: UploadMetadata
UploadMetadata.description: Metadata only; bytes are a separate multipart field. Uploader identity comes from the authenticated caller, never this body.

CodeLists.title: CodeLists
CodeLists.description: Known producer codes. Generated reader types accept future string codes and boundary tooling logs them.

EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope
EventEnvelope.description: Draft common envelope; event-specific data must also validate against its own schema.

ValidationResultReviewed.title: ValidationResultReviewed
ValidationResultReviewed.description: Proposed immutable reviewed snapshot plus a decision-log reference; review actor/provenance needs Power Platform confirmation.

CloseOutCaseChanged.title: CloseOutCaseChanged
CloseOutCaseChanged.description: Internal normalized envelope, NOT an assertion about the raw Dataverse service-endpoint wire format. TODO(verify): capture the external message and map it in one adapter.

transitionOccurrenceId.description: Optional proposed occurrence discriminator; not yet agreed or a deployed Dataverse field.

SharedObject.title: SharedObject
SharedObject.description: Draft logical objects, not physical Dataverse column names. Lifecycle nullability and auxiliary structures require owner review.

ApprovalDecision.title: ApprovalDecision
ApprovalDecision.description: Proposed logical decision structure; physical Dataverse mapping and trusted provenance require Henrik's confirmation.

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
EvidenceRef.description: Proposed version-aware citation, not a SAS token or embedded document.
